translation.name: Mushog Testamento
translation.englishName: Huamalíes-Dos de Mayo Huánuco Quechua NT

content: Lázaro wanushgan
Betania marcachömi targan juc runa Lázaro jutiyog. Paymi pasaypa ansa caycargan. Paypa panincunami cayargan Mariawan Marta.
(Mariami Jesuspa chaquinman perfümita winaparcur agsanwan pisapargan.)
Lázaro ansa caycaptinmi panincuna juc runata Jesusman cachacorgan: “Cuyanacuyashgayqui Läzarumi wanuycanna, taytay” nir wilananpä.
Sayno wilaptinmi Jesús nergan: “Läzaruta say gueshya sarish manami wanushgalancho quëdananpäsu, sinöga noga cawarisimuptë munayyog cashgäta runacuna tantyacuyänanpämi.”

Läzaruwan y panincunawan cuyanacurpis Jesús manami juclaga aywargansu. Saypa trucanga wanunaycashganta wilaycaptinpis cashgan caglachömi ishcay junag goyäcorgan. Saypitanami discïpuluncunata nergan: “Acu cutishun Judea provinciapa.”
Saymi discïpuluncuna niyargan: “Ganyancunarächä saycho cag runacuna samgaypa wanusiyta munayäshushcanqui, taytay. ¿Sayno caycaptincu sayman yapay cutiyta munaycanqui?”

Saymi Jesús nergan: “Ama mansacuyaysu. Wanusimänanpäga manami hörä chämunräsu. Musyashgansinöpis sacaypa puregcunalami mansacuyan. Junagpa puregcunaga manami mansacuyansu. Saynölami wanusiyämänanpä hörä manarä chämuptin gamcunaga mansacuyänayquisu.”
Nircurnami Jesús discïpuluncunata nergan: “Cuyashgansi Läzaroga punucashlami caycan. Acu aywashun ricchasinansipä.”
Sayno niptinmi discïpuluncuna niyargan: “Ali punuyta tariptinmi musyansi aliyänanpä cashganta, taytay.”
Lázaro punucash cashganta nirpis wanush cashgantami Jesús tumasipaylapa nergan. Saymi discïpuluncunaga mana tantyar punucash caycashgalanta yarpäyargan.
Sayno yarpäyaptinmi Jesús discïpuluncunata nergan: “Läzaroga wanushmi caycan.
Wanushganpita cawarisimuptëmi gamcuna más tantyayanquipä Tayta Dios cachamashganta. Saymi cushicö Lázaro cashgan cagcho mana cashgäpita. Pay cagman acu aywashun.”
Saymi Milish niyashgan Tomás discípulu mayincunata nergan: “Sayno captenga nogansipis wanunansipä aywashun.”
Wanushcunata cawarisimunanpä Jesucristo munayyog cashgan
Betaniaman charnami Jesús musyargan chuscu junagna Lázaro pamparaycashganta.
Jerusalenpita Betaniaman media lëwanöla captinmi asca runacuna aywayargan Martatawan Mariata walquiyänanpä.
“Jesusmi shamuycan” negta wiyarmi Marta aywargan taripänanpä. Mariami isanga wayicho quëdacorgan.
Jesuswan tincurmi Marta nergan: “Caycho captiquega turë manachi wanuycunmansu cargan, taytay.
Imano captinpis gammanmi imaypis yäracö. Noga musyämi imata manacuptiquipis Tayta Dios wiyashushgayquita.”
Sayno niptinmi Jesús nergan: “Turiqui cawarimongami.”
Saymi Marta nergan: “Au, musyämi juicio finalcho wanushcuna cawarimuptin turëpis cawarimunanpä cashganta, taytay.”
Niptinmi Jesús nergan: “Nogami cawarisimö wanushcunata. Nogata chasquicamag cagtaga wanuptinpis cawarisimushämi gloriacho imayyagpis cawananpä. ¿Sayta criyinquicu?”
Sayno niptinmi Marta nergan: “Au, taytay. Noga criyëmi. Gammi Tayta Diospa surin caycanqui. Saynöpis caycanqui Tayta Dios cachamushgan Cristumi.”
Läzarupä Jesucristo wagashgan
Sayno nircurmi Marta cutergan nanan María cagman paypis Jesuswan tincog aywananpä. Chaycushpanna gayaycur wilargan: “Jesusmi chämush. Paymi gayaycäshunqui” nir.
Sayno niptin María jucla aywargan.
Jesús manarämi marcaman charganräsu, sinöga Martawan tincushgalanchörämi caycargan.
Wayipita María jucla yargogta ricayashpanmi payta walqueg runacuna guepanta aywayargan: “Turin pamparaycashganmancher aywaycan wagananpä” niyashpan.
Jesús cagman María chaycurmi puntanman gongurpacuycur nergan: “Gam caycho captiquega manami turë wanunmansu cargan, taytay.”
Mariata y walquegnin runacunatapis wagaycagta ricarmi Jesuspis fiyupa laquicorgan.
Saymi paycunata taporgan: “¿Mayninchötä pamparaycan?” nir. Tapuptinmi niyargan: “Maynincho pamparaycashgantapis ricanayquipä aywashun, taytay.”
Pamparashgan cagman aywaycarmi Jesuspis laquicushpan Läzarupä wagargan.
Saymi waquin runacuna niyargan: “Ricay, segaypacher cuyanacuyargan Läzaruwan.”
Waquinnami niyargan: “Gapra runatapis aliyaycäserga ¿manasurä Läzarutapis aliyäsinman cargan mana wanunanpä?”
Lázaro cawarimushgan
Fiyupa laquishmi Jesús chargan Lázaro pamparashgan cagman. Say pamparashgan sepultüraga cargan gagacho uchcushmi. Puncunnami saparargan jatun rumiwan.
Sayman chaycurmi Jesús nergan: “Saparaycag rumita witisiyay.” Sayno niptinmi Läzarupa panin Marta nergan: “Chuscu junagnami pamparaycan, taytay. Cananyäga segaypanacher asyaycan.”
Sayno niptin Jesús nergan: “¿Manacu nishcä nogaman yäracamaptiquega turiquita cawarisimunäpä cashganta?”

Sauraga saparaycag rumita witircasiyaptinnami ciëluta ricärir Jesús nergan: “Manacushgäta imaypis wiyamashgayquipitami gamta agradëcicamö, papá. Yanapämashgayquita ricarmi caycho caycag runacuna tantyayangapä gam cachamashgayquita.”
Nircurnami Jesús fuertipa nergan: “¡Lázaro, yargamuy!”
Sayno niptinmi wanush jitaraycashganpita cawarircamur Lázaro yargamorgan uman wancush y maquin chaquin wancush. Yargaramuptinnami Jesús nergan: “Purinanpä pascayay.”
Jesucristuta wanusiyänanpä mandag cüracuna wilanacuyashgan
Läzaruta cawarisimushganta ricaycurmi Mariata walqueg runacuna ascag criyiyargan Jesusta Tayta Dios cachamushganta.
Waquin cagnami fariseo runacunaman aywaycur wilayargan Läzaruta cawarisimuptin asca runacuna payman criyiycäyashganta.

Sayta wiyaycurmi mandag cüracunawan fariseo runacuna Israel runacunapa autoridänincunata gayaycasir niyargan: “Milagrucunata ruraptin aläpanami runacuna criyiycäyan Dios cachamushgan Cristo cashganta. ¿Imatatä rurashun say runata?

Payta prësu mana sarisishgaga milagro rurashgancunata ricar lapan runacunami munayanga nacionninsipa mandagnin rey cananta. Sayta wiyaycurmi Romacho mandag emperador fiyupa rabiacushpan soldäduncunata cachamonga templunsita juchusiyänanpä y lapansitapis wanusimänansipä.”
Sayno niyaptin más mandag cüra Caifás nergan: “¡Gamcunaga manami imatapis tantyayanquisu!
Templunsita mana juchusinanpä y mana ushacäsimänansipä say runala wanusun. Saynöpami lapansipis salvacushunpä.”

“Say runala wanusun lapansi salvacunansipä” nir Caifás nergan Roma runacuna Israel runacunata ushacäsiyänanta mana munarmi. Payga manami tantyargansu jusansicunapita wanur Jesús salvamänansipä cashganta. Mana tantyaptinpis sayno parlananpä Tayta Dios yarpayninman churargan más mandag cüra say wata captinmi. Caifás nishgannölami Jesús wanorgan Israel runacunata y mana Israel runacunatapis salvananpä.
Say junagpitanami autoridäcuna wilanacuyargan Jesusta wanusiyänanpä.

Sayta musyarmi Israel runacunapa autoridänincuna ricayga Jesús purergannasu. Saymi Judea provinciapita Jesús discïpuluncunawan aywacuyargan Efraín nishgan marcaman saycho goyäyänanpä. Say marcaga sunyag jirca cercalanchömi caycan.
Say junagcuna Pascua galaycunanpäna caycaptinmi marcancunapita asca runacuna Jerusalenman aywayargan Tayta Dios nishganno say fiestapä puestucog.
Templo patiuchönami runacuna niyargan: “Gamcunaga ¿imatatä yarpäyanqui? ¿Fiestapä Jesús shamongasurä o manasurä?” niyashpan.
Fariseo runacunawan mandag cüracuna maynami runacunata nish cashga: “Jesusta maychöpis ricashpayquega jucla wilayämanqui prësu sarisiyänäpä.”
